name: agentcode
description: Agentic AI coding assistant — Claude, GPT, Gemini, inline completions, cost-aware routing, open source

agentcode.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key (sk-...). Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key. Falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY in the workspace .env file or environment.

agentcode.model.description: Default LLM model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o, gemini/gemini-2.5-pro)

agentcode.executablePath.description: Path to the agentcode executable (default: agentcode from PATH)

agentcode.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Enable inline code completions (defaults to Claude Haiku; override with a custom endpoint below)

agentcode.inlineCompletions.endpoint.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint for completions (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, or a HuggingFace Inference Endpoint URL). When set, used instead of Claude Haiku.

agentcode.inlineCompletions.model.description: Model name to request from the custom endpoint (e.g. hf.co/Vigp17/agentcode-3b for Ollama, or your deployed model name).

agentcode.inlineCompletions.apiKey.description: Optional API key for the custom endpoint (leave blank for local Ollama). Falls back to AGENTCODE_COMPLETION_API_KEY in .env.
